Exceptional Quirk.name: Exceptional Quirk
Exceptional Quirk.description:
🌟 Your Quirk is far stronger than most of its kind, and people notice.

🌱 Beyond the starting reach and force your Quirk's card describes, from day one.
⚠️ Every use strains you twice as hard: Quirk Strain per use is doubled.
⚠️ Your drawback shows sooner, from Quirk Strain 50.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +5
Exceptional Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: The Quirk works above its family's starting scale: more force, range, area and duration than a typical new user's, enough that holding back is a skill the user must practice. Each use builds double the usual Quirk Strain, and the drawback starts to show at 50 instead of 60; it turns active at 80, and at 100 the Quirk gives out or the body pays, as for anyone. A few big uses in a row push the user into the active drawback. Attention follows: hero agencies send scouts and offers, the Hero Public Safety Commission keeps a file and watches for misuse, villains see a prize to recruit or a threat to remove, and reporters and classmates measure the user against top heroes. Accidents with a Quirk this strong hurt people and make the news. If the character chose Quirkless, this trait does not apply: they have no Quirk, never gain Quirk Strain, and draw none of this attention.
